name: ssh-tmux-reattach-baseline
purpose: Measure whether a remote SSH/tmux process survives an app background cycle and whether the controller can reattach with a truthful transcript
steps: Start a unique tmux session on the remote host through the native SSH PTY
Arm a bounded remote marker that prints after a delay
Background the app so the controller drops the SSH connection
Return the app to the foreground and wait for a fresh terminal.ssh.ready event
Verify the delayed marker is visible after reattach and that new input is accepted
